title: Make the AI explain line by line
why_it_matters: Understanding the code is the whole point of learning with AI.
explanation: Instead of only asking for a fix, paste the code and ask for each line explained. Tell it your level, for example: strong in HTML and CSS, new to JavaScript. Then explain it back in your own words.
try_it: Pick one function from your project and ask for a line-by-line explanation.
